description: Iris is an AI-powered RFP and proposal intelligence platform. This MCP server gives your AI assistant secure access to your Iris workspace — query your RFP pipeline, retrieve open assignments, search the knowledge base, check win/loss statistics, and pull executive summaries, all in natural language. Authentication is handled via OAuth 2.1 + PKCE — no API keys required
